purpose: Document first-party English/Thai discovery and bounded anonymous service review for Khon Kaen; no runtime/catalog integration.
assessment: Official first-party sources confirm the Department of Lands as the national cadastral authority and the Khon Kaen Provincial Land Office as a local registry custodian. The reachable LandsPublic viewer is scoped to public/state-land documents and provides a map interface, not a verified complete cadastral parcel layer. No safe native parcel identity plus full polygon was obtained, so no sample GeoJSON was written.
registryAssessment: true for custodian/procedure evidence only; this does not establish citywide public parcel-geometry coverage.

officialSources.observation: Official Khon Kaen Provincial Land Office website, reachable anonymously (HTTP 200), identifies the provincial office and branches and links DOL services/procedures. It does not expose a parcel vector endpoint in the inspected page.

Official DOL LandsPublic viewer, reachable anonymously (HTTP 200), describes the Land Parcel Map Information Center and public/state-land document layers. The UI includes coordinate search and map interaction but is not evidence of a complete private-parcel cadastre.

Official DOL Land Parcel Map Information Center page (HTTP 200) lists Lands State, LandsPublic, CondoMaps and iPortal services; it does not provide a directly verified anonymous citywide parcel geometry response.

Official DOL homepage identifies LandsMaps as the parcel-shape search service, but the service host could not be anonymously reached within the bounded request timeout. No login or access-control workaround was attempted.

Official DOL technical standard documents parcel-related native fields such as PARCEL_ID and PIN for state-land map tables. This is schema/procedure evidence only; no row values or geometry were read or retained.

requestChecks.observation: Anonymous HTML viewer fetched; inspected JavaScript loads map tiles and a point lookup route for public/state-land data.

Exact WUP coordinate request was attempted without credentials. The server returned an access-denied HTML response; this is not evidence of parcel absence. No retry with bypass or altered coordinates was made.

Official local land-office homepage fetched anonymously (249517 bytes). Links and page text identify the provincial office and branches, but no safe parcel geometry API was exposed in the page inspected.
Bounded anonymous request timed out after 15 seconds. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, credential, token, or TLS exception was used.
The route is the viewer's exact-point public/state-land lookup route as found in the current JavaScript configuration. Response body was an access-denied page, not a parcel feature response.
